dustin: Why does Dustin bring a ladder to the shack? He heard the band was finally opening up.
Dustin called CQ for so long his coffee turned into cold brew.
Dustin's antenna is so tall the birds have to file a flight plan.
Dustin tried working DX from the basement. He made solid contact with the water heater.
The XYL asked Dustin if he'd ever stop buying radios. He said negative, over.
Why is Dustin great at parties? He always makes contact.
Dustin says the shack is organized. He calls the system spectrum analysis.
Dustin's logbook is thicker than the phone book and twice as hard to lift.
Dustin doesn't own an alarm clock. The 40 meter net starts at 7 sharp.
Dustin's tower is so tall the FAA sent him a birthday card.
Why did Dustin fail geometry? He kept insisting every shape was a dipole.
Dustin swore he heard Australia last night. It was the ceiling fan.
Dustin's idea of a vacation is a portable operation in his own driveway.
Why won't Dustin play hide and seek? He keeps transmitting his position.
Dustin brought home a new rig and told the XYL it was a smoke detector.
Dustin's coax run is so long it qualifies for its own zip code.
Why is Dustin never lonely? He gets 73 friends every single night.
Dustin hung a wire in the maple. Now the squirrels have better range than he does.
Dustin's SWR got so bad the antenna tuner filed for overtime pay.
Why did Dustin get shushed at the library? He kept calling CQ.
Dustin says his handwriting is perfectly clear. It's just CW.
Dustin drove his ground rod so deep he waves at the neighbors in Australia.
Why did Dustin bring a box fan to Field Day? To improve the airwaves.
Dustin named the cat Roger. Now he never has to say it twice.
Dustin's mobile rig has more buttons than his truck has miles.
Why is Dustin terrible at keeping secrets? Everything he says goes out broadcast.
Dustin says the shack is a temporary setup. It's been temporary since 1998.
Dustin's antenna analyzer finally told him the truth. They haven't spoken since.
Why does Dustin love thunderstorms? Free static with no monthly subscription.
Dustin ordered one more radio. The XYL ordered one more shelf.
Dustin's HT has a 12 hour battery and he has an 11 hour attention span.
Dustin got a new soldering iron for his birthday. The smoke detector got a workout.
Why does Dustin talk to the ionosphere? It's the only one that bounces him back.
Dustin says he's cutting back on antennas. He's down to one per tree.
